title: AI Designed 16 Working Viruses From 700,000 Variants
description:
AI just designed 16 working viruses 🧬 Arc Institute and Stanford used Evo 1 and Evo 2 models, trained on trillions of nucleotides, to generate 700k candidates. 285 got tested, 16 came out alive, and some replicate faster then natural phages 🔥 They only infect E. coli. Describing a pathogen is info. Designing a genome is a tool, and regulators dont see that line yet.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
